title: A Tutorial on Diffusion Theory: From Differential Equations to Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.22586v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion models have emerged as a leading framework for generative modeling, yet their mathematical foundations are often presented in separate treatments. This tutorial offers a unified, self-contained introduction organized into three parts. First, we construct a forward generative stochastic differential equation (SDE) that transports noise to data, marginalize over the clean data endpoint, and derive training objectives directly from the forward dynamics. Second, we begin with a conditional path from data to noise, marginalize it to obtain the forward process, and derive the corresponding reverse-time SDE and training objectives. Within this forward-reverse framework, we also establish the connection between denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) and variance-preserving (VP) SDEs. translated_title: 扩散理论教程：从微分方程到扩散模型
translated_abstract: 扩散模型已成为生成建模的主流框架，但其数学基础往往以各自独立的方式呈现。本教程提供了一个统一的、自成体系的介绍，共分为三个部分。首先，我们构建一个将噪声传输至数据的前向生成随机微分方程（SDE），对干净数据端点进行边缘化处理，并直接从前向动力学推导训练目标。其次，我们从数据到噪声的条件路径出发，将其边缘化以获得前向过程，并推导相应的反向时间SDE和训练目标。在这一前向-反向框架中，我们还建立了去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）与方差保持（VP）SDE之间的联系。第三，我们回顾了求解SDE的数值方法，并讨论了两种引导生成的方法：分类器引导和无分类器引导。
tldr: 本教程从前向与反向随机微分方程两个视角统一介绍扩散模型的数学基础，推导训练目标，建立DDPM与VP-SDE的联系，并涵盖SDE数值求解方法与引导生成技术。
